notes.text: PThU studies theology in the Protestant Christian tradition. The UCR plan explores belief, meaning and the public role of religion through philosophy, history, the arts and social science.

Theology, biblical exegesis and supervised pastoral practice require dedicated study. PThU also offers a route in which students replace the language and exegesis courses with other theology courses and interreligious practice.

audience.programmeDescription: This Dutch-taught bachelor studies Christian theology, faith, meaning and religious practice in the Protestant tradition.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The PThU example shows Systematic Theology with biblical languages. The UCR plan explores worldviews through philosophy, cultural history and public life.
